text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The promised Derby. Sakura Chiyono O was 
unable to seize victory. She struck the 
turf, tasting the bitterness of defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she still had another goal: to 
"get stronger and race alongside 
Maruzensky." Sakura Chiyono O wipes away 
her tears and stands back up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her, Maruzensky smiled with 
satisfaction to herself, resolved to 
fulfill their "final promise."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Competing with her rivals led to Sakura 
Chiyono O's growth and gave her new 
strength. She wishes to keep running 
alongside them. However—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of them, Mejiro Ardan, collapsed. Her 
legs had become brittle from the toll of 
pushing herself past her limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rival was about to walk away from the 
racing world. However, Sakura Chiyono O 
swore that as her rival, she would 
definitely keep her from leaving.
